rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Retrieves Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts through the Microsoft Graph API using delegated OAuth 2.0 On-Behalf-Of (OBO) authentication. Provides tools to list recent meetings, fetch cleaned speaker-attributed transcripts with VTT metadata stripped, and save transcripts to SharePoint for archival. Designed for deployment on Azure Container Apps with stateless Streamable HTTP transport, supporting integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio and other MCP-compatible clients.
